Tara (Sales): Ibrahim, Maya's POC in a DMZ network is seeing SSE drop mid-stream. Browser logs show 'Unexpected end of JSON input' when parsing event.data. Happens on slow mobile and through their corporate gateway.

Ibrahim (SE): Can you paste a raw fragment and SDK version? Common culprits: proxy compression/buffering or older SDK that doesn't preserve incomplete UTF-8 across chunks.

Maya (Client Eng): Raw (redacted):
```
data: {\"id\":\"p-77\",\"frag\":\"{\\\"msg\\\":\\\"Bonn\"\n\n```
then:
```
data: {\"id\":\"p-77\",\"frag\":\"jour\\\"}\n\n```
They call JSON.parse per event; fails when a multibyte or chunk split occurs. SDK is `@redwood/web-sdk@1.3.x` via CDN.

Ibrahim (SE): Quick fixes: 1) ask infra to disable gzip / proxy_buffering for the streaming route, 2) force websocket fallback for the demo (`transport:'websocket'` in SDK), or 3) client-side reassembly buffering keyed by id until complete JSON. Also we've shipped a decoder fix in newer SDK patches; recommend upgrade.

Maya (Client Eng): They can't touch DMZ proxy before demo. Please send a tiny reassembly snippet and websocket snippet.

Ibrahim (SE): Snippets: 1) websocket: `new RedwoodClient({transport:'websocket', token:'xxx'})`. 2) reassembly: accumulate per-id fragments and attempt JSON.parse only when braces balance or parse succeeds. Works well for demos.

deploy-bot: Rolled out stream-dmz-fix v2026.11.04 by @ibrahim  includes web-sdk 1.3.9 with incremental UTF-8 buffering.

Tara (Sales): I'll propose websocket fallback for the live demo and share the buffer snippet. Maya, please send HAR/curl output after testing so we can close the POC blocker. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
